## Outcome

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and task IDs.

## Scope and contracts

Owned files, interface/config impact, approval/ADR reference if required, data/split/metric scope.

## Verification

Actual commands and outcomes. State what was not run and why. Link immutable experiment artifacts
for ML changes; no synthetic-to-official claims or hidden-label tuning.

## Handoff and integration

Unique handoff path, existing implementation commit, remaining work/risks, required reviewer,
and any proposed shared-summary updates for Ayush. Do not claim a local-only artifact is shared.
